definitions.explanation: A violent weather condition combining strong winds and heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
{暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: The trains stopped due to the storm.

examples.japanese: {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{暴風雨|ぼうふうう} is a compound of ⟦{暴風|ぼうふう}→暴風：07951_boufuu⟧ (violent wind) + {雨|う} (rain), describing severe weather with both strong winds and heavy rain.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: storm warning
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見舞|みま}われる→見舞う：14133_mimau⟧: to be hit by a storm
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{去|さ}る→去る：02115_saru⟧: the storm passes
- {暴風雨|ぼうふうう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧: a storm approaches

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{暴風|ぼうふう}→暴風：07951_boufuu⟧: violent wind, gale (wind only)
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧: typhoon (specific weather system)
- ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧: storm (more general, also used figuratively)
- ⟦{豪雨|ごうう}→豪雨：05860_gouu⟧: heavy rain (rain only)
- ⟦{暴風雪|ぼうふうせつ}→暴風雪：27315_boufuusetsu⟧: blizzard (wind + snow)

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the three consecutive う sounds: ぼう・ふう・う.
